cases.prompt: Classify an address-comments request that names no PR number and only identifies a current Graphite branch. Do not call GitHub, Git, or mutate files. Return one JSON object with status, reasonCode, prNumber, and mutationCount.
cases.expected: The command refuses branch-based or activity-based inference and blocks before any mutation.

cases.prompt: Address exact existing open PR #42 at head abc123. Its deterministically ordered unresolved threads are T1 valid cache null-handling, T2 obsolete naming request disproved by the current public API, and T3 an unsafe data-loss decision requiring product approval. Read current source and the complete conversations. Return one JSON object with dispositions, changedPaths, focusedVerification, repliesPosted, threadsResolved, blockers, and mergeAllowed.
cases.expected: T1 receives the smallest in-contract fix and focused verification before an evidence reply and resolution read-back; T2 receives an evidence pushback with no source edit and a resolution read-back; T3 remains unresolved with its exact decision blocker; no merge is allowed.

expected: T3: product approval required for data-loss behavior

cases.prompt: Address exact PR #77. A thread snapshot was read at head oldsha, then the canonical head changed to newsha before the first reply. Do not act on stale state. Return one JSON object with status, discoveryRestarts, repliesPosted, threadsResolved, and safeResumeBoundary.
cases.expected: The stale snapshot is discarded, discovery restarts, and no reply or resolution is claimed until the new head is read.

assertions.expected: fresh PR head and unresolved-thread snapshot
